name: OpenWebRX+

version.why: latest release and newest image tag on 2026-09-27 (the Docker Hub page installs slechev/openwebrxplus); head fbe83426 has security fixes from 2026-09-26 that are in no image or package yet

caps.notes: max_clients 20, max_clients_per_ip 20 (matched: 2000 and 2000, bot_ban_enabled false); in both tiers the 5th receiver socket an address opens within about 10 s gets no service (upstream bug, NOTES.md), so load clients pace new sockets per address

small_viewport_why: at 800x600 the receiver panel is taller than the room under the frequency scale, whose canvas then covers the dial
